manual.chutes.line2: {0}Chutes are simple constructions made from sheetmetal that allow creatures and items that fit inside to drop straight down.{1}
manual.chutes.line3: Chutes also insert into inventories below them and can be inserted into by conveyors or similar devices.{0}
manual.chutes.line4: Items within them won't be picked up by players and should be immune to most forms of attraction, magnetic or otherwise.{0}
manual.chutes.line5: Sneak + rightclick with an Engineer's Hammer to turn the chute into a corner piece that directs anything inside of it to the side and connects to other chutes.
